## Core Disciplines

- **[Technical SEO Audits](/method/technical-seo-audit)**: Crawl paths, indexability, canonicals, internal links, templates, metadata, structured data, and performance inputs.
- **[AI Crawler Access Audits](/method/ai-crawler-access-audit)**: Robots rules, crawler access, entity pages, schema, citation surfaces, and source text checks.
- **[Indexation Audits](/method/indexation-audit)**: Sitemap cleanup, canonical URLs, old URL redirects, noindex decisions, and Search Console validation.
- **[Internal Link Audits](/method/internal-link-audit)**: Crawl depth, inlinks, orphan candidates, anchor text, and hub-page support.
- **[Finance Research](/markets/valuation-research)**: Valuation models, market research, operating assumptions, dashboards, and research notes.
- **[Crypto Market Structure](/markets/crypto-market-structure)**: Token incentives, protocol fees, liquidity, emissions, governance, and risk frameworks.
- **[Web Interfaces & Reports](/atlas)**: React/Vite pages, audit dashboards, portfolio pages, exports, and report design.

## Key Projects & Case Studies

- **[Atlas SEO Audit Console](/atlas)**: A crawl-based audit console for indexation, architecture, internal links, canonicals, structured data, performance inputs, and crawler access checks.
- **[Markets Research](/markets)**: Finance and market-structure notes built as structured artifacts. Thin notes are labeled by status and depth, with TODO/source-needed evidence fields where proof is missing.
- **[Network Monopolies](/markets/network-monopolies)**: Platform-power memo covering network effects, switching costs, pricing power, regulation, and AI distribution risk.
- **[Computational Commodity Systems](/markets/computational-commodity-systems)**: Compute and AI infrastructure note covering utilization, energy, provider margins, and commodity pressure.
- **[Fiat Horizon](/markets/fiat-horizon)**: Money, debt, currency trust, real-rate, and hard-asset horizon note.
- **[Void Agency Method](/method)**: Technical SEO audits for crawlability, indexation, internal links, schema, analytics, and AI crawler access checks.
